display.description: Cost, token and latency monitoring for Meta Muse Spark via the Meta Model API, built on gen_ai.* trace attributes. Panels filter gen_ai.provider.name = 'meta' so Muse Spark calls stay separate from other providers reached through the same OpenAI-compatible SDK.

display.description: Sum of gen_ai.cost.total_cost. Correct only when cached input is priced separately; span-derived cost overstates by 3-5x without it.
